theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds: Separating Fact from Fiction
body: Mutual funds aren't just for the wealthy. They're accessible investment vehicles allowing small investors to participate in diversified portfolios with professional management.
caption: Think mutual funds require huge capital? Think again. Start small, invest regularly, and let diversification work for you. Education is your best investment tool. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #FinancialLiteracy #DemystifyingInvestments #SmartInvesting
